_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to knowledge_base/sports/<sport_id>.json (a pack in the athlete repo overrides the base plugin on an id collision: same relative path, local wins), rename sport_id to match the filename, then replace every value below. Conforms to _schema.md — diff cycling.json for a complete worked example. The primary zone key is '<fitness_marker>_pct'; zones must be ordered by id (1..n) and contiguous over the marker range. hr_zones is the transversal 5-zone HR system — declare it even when an athlete lacks max_hr / lthr_bpm. Keep at least one active-recovery key_session.
references: Cite the book / article / source backing these zones and key sessions.

endurance_long.purpose: Aerobic base volume (describe its role in this sport)
